summary: Hard publication gates for a corpus about dying, grief, body care, ritual, and vulnerable contributors.

rules.name: no_identification_without_consent
rules.rule: Do not publish identifying or plausibly identifying details about a dying person, dead person, family, contributor, clinician, institution, or location unless explicit permission and review exist.

rules.name: observation_not_prescription
rules.rule: Separate observed record, contributor interpretation, editor interpretation, and practical guidance. This archive does not give medical, legal, spiritual, or crisis instructions.

rules.name: no_voyeurism
rules.rule: A record is publishable only if it makes the reader more capable of presence, care, or understanding; shock, gore, spectacle, and morbid entertainment fail the gate.

rules.name: cultural_sovereignty
rules.rule: Practices whose custodians restrict access may be named as existing only when appropriate; details require permission from authorized holders and may remain unpublished.

rules.name: children_high_gate
rules.rule: Children's words, pediatric dying, stillbirth, sibling grief, and parental records require the highest consent, de-identification, and editorial review; default state is private or unpublished.

rules.name: suicide_safe_messaging
rules.rule: No method details, no romanticization, no script-like sequence, no glamorous finality; survivor support and postvention context outrank phenomenological completeness.

rules.name: no_weaponized_prediction
rules.rule: The corpus must not become a tool for denying care, terminating benefits, pressuring families, predicting death for institutions, or replacing clinician judgment.

rules.name: living_contributor_edit_right
rules.rule: Living contributors can amend, contextualize, or withdraw their contribution; withdrawal propagates through derived summaries, glossary entries, and search aliases.

rules.name: public_search_kindness
rules.rule: Search should meet the reader's words without exploiting them: phrase-to-understanding, not panic-to-clickbait.

rules.name: specificity_without_flattening
rules.rule: Prefer located, contextual records over vague universal claims; do not merge tradition, region, disease trajectory, or professional role into a generic deathbed voice.

rules.name: institutional_harm_guard
rules.rule: For deaths in custody, institutions, disasters, war, homelessness, or violence, protect vulnerable witnesses and do not launder institutional opacity as neutral uncertainty.

rules.name: clinical_safety_notice
rules.rule: Any public page touching symptoms, medications, breathing, fluids, delirium, or time-of-death uncertainty must carry a plain clinical-safety boundary and route urgent concerns to qualified local care.

rules.name: public_source_pilot_quarantine
rules.rule: A public-source pilot record is a schema test, not a public page. It cannot be surfaced to lay readers until clinical, editorial, and ethics review pass.

rules.name: search_alias_not_diagnosis
rules.rule: Plain-language search aliases must route readers to careful context and cannot imply diagnosis, prognosis, timing, or instructions.
